reviews.title: Good but…
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Down fall is you have to a very large amount for it to be able to blend properly. I wanted to be able to have the choice to do it a meal at a time if I wanted to. I feel like it should work no matter how much I make at a time

reviews.title: Rubber Gear of nutri bullet baby melts
reviews.review_text: Rubber Gear of nutri bullet baby melts and mixes with baby food . We have been feeding our baby for the past 10 days without realizing rubber was getting into baby food . While feeding sweet potato purée we realized the difference . Please find the difference in attached pictures (blackish purée is from nutri bullet and the other was from a different blender )

reviews.title: It's cute to look at and that's about it
reviews.review_text: The blade part leaks black lubricant after a few months of average use. When you contact warranty they say you're supposed to replace that part every 6-12 months but that information is only in the FAQs online and not in any of the material provided when you purchase the item. We got a new blade and after 3x a week use it's leaking the black lubricant again after 3.5 months. Also there are no measurements on anything, which is really inconvenient if you're keeping track of portions.
